title: fix: return 400 for invalid image URLs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Returns HTTP 400 when Portkey reports its status-less invalid image URL validation error.
- Keeps genuine status-less provider failures classified as 502.
- Prevents invalid image requests from being recorded as server errors in model health.
- Adds an endpoint-level regression test covering the public response and telemetry behavior.

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write gen.pollinations.ai/src/text/genericOpenAIClient.ts gen.pollinations.ai/test/error-observability.test.ts`
- `npx vitest run test/error-observability.test.ts test/text/genericOpenAIClient.test.ts` (27 passed)
- `npm run typecheck` (Gen)

gist.headline: Bad URLs, Properly Labeled
gist.blurb: Invalid image URLs now get the little 400 they were always meant to receive. The model-health garden no longer mistakes a malformed request for a sick provider.
gist.summary: The text generation gateway now maps Portkey's status-less invalid image URL validation error to HTTP 400 while preserving genuine status-less provider failures as HTTP 502.
gist.impact: Developers sending an invalid image URL receive a clear client-error response, and those requests no longer count as server errors in model-health telemetry.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful API gardener, inspecting an image-URL seed that has a tiny malformed tag and placing it in a clearly labeled 400 compost bin, while healthy provider flowers remain untouched. A nearby CRT monitor robot displays separate 400 and 502 status tiles, representing accurate error classification and clean telemetry.
